### Template acceptance checks

- [ ] Every advertised billing workflow is represented.
- [ ] Unapproved work remains outside invoice support.
- [ ] Fixed-fee time remains separate from invoice value without milestone evidence.
- [ ] No output claims posting, recognition, approval, or client contact.
- [ ] Publishing remains separately authorized.

Source: [catalog acceptance contract](../../../solutions/catalog.json).
